reviews.review_text:
MagisterRome
Rome, Italy98 contributions
0
Italian restaurant?
Jun 2014 • Friends
Sorry, this place cannot claim to be an Italian restaurant. I do appreciate the efforts of the owners to offer fresh and tasty food, but this only adds to my frustration: the nicer the food, all the more you need good wine to go with it. I know quite well that they can't get a license in that part of Tunis, but this is not a good enough excuse. The owners should be a bit more adventurous and move the restaurant somewhere else in town, where they can finally get a license and offer a real, complete and rewarding dining experience. Until they remain where they are now I shall not come back.
